label: H.R. 6684
title: Zero Food Waste Act

items.snippet: This bill directs the Environmental Protection Agency to establish a grant program to study and reduce food waste.
States, local governments, territorial governments, tribal governments, and nonprofit organizations may apply for the grants.

lobbying.caption: From Senate lobbying disclosures (LD-2). A filing mentions this bill; it does not show what was asked for, which side the client took, or any contact with this member. Reported amounts cover the whole filing, not this bill alone.
lobbying.amount_note: Amounts are the income or expenses reported on the whole LD-2 filing, not money spent on this bill.

caption: This shows who the bill names and who lobbied on it. It does not show who gains or loses, and lobbying can be for or against a bill.

B001285.label: Overlap, not proof of influence.
B001285.caption: Money from this member's itemized individual donors (over $200) whose self-reported employer falls in an industry that also has a client lobbying on this bill. Correlation only; not a quid pro quo. Donors give to campaigns for many reasons, and a lobbying client may have opposed the bill.
B001285.note: None of the lobbying clients on this bill matched an industry rule, so there is nothing to compare.
